title: Request By Mr. M. Hashizume For Information Re The Kwang

page_data.en:
Form No. 2.
G. 000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C & S B REGISTRY
V D 3967
Special Branch, S.B. Station
29 / 7 / 32
Date, August 27, 1932.

Subject (in full) Request by Mr. M. Hashizume for information re:
the Kwang Hwa (光華) Book Store, 552 Foochow Road.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached report of D.C. Imamura
dated August 9 on the subject of certain postal remittances
forwarded on July 23, 1932 to one Kwah Kai Tsung (許開貞)
residing at No.276 Suwada, Kokubumura, Higashi Katsurgi-gori,
Chiba, Japan, from the Kwang Hwa Book Store, 552 Foochow Road,
and a certain local resident named Zung Sing Nan (鄭心南),
I have to report that according to discreet enquiries made by
this office, the management of the Kwang Hwa Book Store whose
offices are located on the 2nd floor of No.512 Foochow Road,
state that in view of the fact that Kwah Kai Tsung is unknown
to them, they have not any occasion had business transactions
with anyone answering to this name.
Zung Sing Nan (鄭心南) is not known to the
employees of the bookstore in question and there is nothing
in Police records concerning this individual.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
5.2
Convey this information
to Mr. Hashizume - verbally
[Initials]
O/c S.B. [Initials]
Information conveyed by Dc Imamura.
[Signature] 31/8.

（印：FILE T.O.C./C.S.B）

表格第2号。
G. 000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
V D 3967
特别分部，特别分部警署
1932年7月29日
日期：1932年8月27日。

主题（全称）桥爪（Hashizume）先生请求提供关于福州路552号光华书局的信息。

由督察顾保华呈报。经由 [签名] 转呈

参照附带的今村巡官于8月9日提交的关于以下事项的报告：1932年7月23日从福州路552号光华书局以及一位名为郑心南的本地居民，向居住于日本千叶县东葛饰郡国分村须和田276号的许开贞汇出的某些邮政汇款。本人谨此报告，经本处秘密查访，位于福州路512号二楼的光华书局管理层表示，鉴于他们并不认识许开贞，因此从未与任何符合此姓名的人进行过业务往来。
该书店员工并不认识郑心南，且警方档案中亦无关于此人的记录。

顾保华
督察

特别分部主管警官。
5.2
将此信息口头传达给桥爪先生
[首字母缩写]
特别分部主管 [首字母缩写]
信息由今村巡官传达。
[签名] 8月31日。

（印章：FILE T.O.C./C.S.B）

Form No. 2.
G. 45,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Special Branch S. 1. Station,
REPORT
Date August 9, 1932.

Subject (in full) Request by Mr. M. Hashizume for information on the Kwang
Hwa Book Store.

Made by D. C. Inamura. Forwarded by

Mr. Alaris' assistant Mr. M. Hashizume requests
that an enquiry be made regarding the following names:-
Kwang Hwa Book Store, (光華書局) No. 502 Foochow Road.
Zung Sing Nan. (鄭心南)
and to verify if that on July 23, remittances were made by means
of postal orders, to the amount of Y. 142.84 for K. Sato, the 1st.
son of Kwah Kai Tsung, (郭復) at No. 276 Suwada, Kokubumura,
Higashi Katsuragi-gori, Chiba, Japan, from Kwang Hwa Book Store
in Shanghai, and the sum of Y. 350.00 for Kwah Kai Tsung from
Zung Sing Nan in Shanghai. What are reasons - what
connection with Kwah Kai Tsung, they have?

D. C. Inamura
D. C.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

82, For discreet inquiry
and report please.
J. I. Kahn
ABR 9/8
9.8.32.

G. 45,000-1-32

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
特别分部 S. 1. 警署，
报告
日期：1932年8月9日。

主题（全称）桥爪先生请求提供关于光华书局的信息。

由今村巡官呈报。经由 转呈

阿拉里斯（Alaris）先生的助手桥爪先生请求对以下姓名进行调查：
光华书局，（光華書局）福州路502号。
郑心南。（鄭心南）
并核实是否于7月23日通过邮政汇票，从上海光华书局向日本千叶县东葛饰郡国分村须和田276号的郭复（Kwah Kai Tsung，许开贞之子）汇出金额为142.84日元（Y. 142.84）的款项，以及从上海的郑心南向郭复汇出金额为350.00日元（Y. 350.00）的款项。原因是什么——他们与郭复有何关联？

今村
巡官

特别分部主管警官。

82，请进行秘密调查并具报。
J. I. Kahn
ABR 8月9日
1932年8月9日。
